svg.aria-label: Plugins you can install: Discord by NotCavnfox, version 1.0.0; FlareSolverr by wozniakpawel, version 1.0.1; Language Checker by roychassi, version 1.0.1; Tailscale by CoderLuii, version 1.0.0; Language Packs by CoderLuii, version 1.0.0

g.text: A Discord bot for your server: account linking, self-updating library tiles,
requests from Discord and a message when a request is available.
Gets Sources past a site's bot check (Cloudflare, DDoS-Guard) with the FlareSolverr
Turns down releases HolyArrs refuses for a missing audio language, so they are
blocklisted for that movie or episode and searched again.
Reach HolyArrs from anywhere through your own Tailscale network, without opening
ports. Sign-in is still required for every visit.
HolyArrs in 43 more languages. Pick yours during setup or in My account.
